objective: Prove the Control Room Ahora conversation projection with a second real recovered chat of a different data shape, without creating a new model or authority.

second_chat.title: STT Live · gris→blanco, Live Rail y máquina de escribir

verification.unrelated_boundary: Notes exact-back reload timeout waiting for #prometeoChangeLoop.open

learning: The projection pattern works across two real recovered chats from different project contexts.
Recovery INDEX entries can be sparse; the renderer must not require rich purpose/important_ideas fields.
Detailed recovery content remains available through entry_ref and should be fetched only when richer display/actions require it.
The second canary required no new conversation model, backend, scheduler, queue, Workspace authority, or Widget authority.
next_action: Replace the two chat-specific canary adapters with one data-driven conversation projection that selects recovery entries marked control_room_now=true, while preserving Chat Recovery V2 as source owner and sparse-index tolerance.
